scope: Affinity purification - mass spectrometry analysis of N-terminally FLAG-tagged ACAD11 transietly expressed in HEK293 cells.
Two milligrams of protein was incubated with 40 μl of μMACS Anti-DYKDDDDK beads (Miltenyi Biotech, 130–101-591) for 45 min with rotation at 4 °C.
The suspension was separated with a μMACS column and magnetic separator, and washed with lysis buffer containing only 0.01% CHAPS followed by lysis buffer containing no CHAPS.
Proteins were eluted with 2 M urea in 50 mM Tris, pH 7.5, containing 1 mM DTT, 5 mM iodoacetamide and 125 ng of trypsin (Promega, V5111), and digested overnight at room temperature.
